feed.title: You can build you next AI App with Gemini, for free, in less than 90 seconds...
feed.summary:
You can get 1,500,000,000 tokes for free everyday with the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. Get started at https://aistudio.google.com, get your API key in 3 clicks, and then head to the Gemini API docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs to explore pricing, rate limits, more verbose examples for some of our key features and more. 

There has never been a better time to build with Gemini. If you run into any issues or have questions, email me: lkilpatrick@google.com or send me a DM on Twitter: https://twitter.com/OfficialLoganK

It's time to build!
